entities.name: Fernando Alonso
entities.description: He scored points in eight races and achieved one podium finish: a third place at the Singapore Grand Prix. Alonso won pole position for the Hungarian Grand Prix and led the first twelve laps before he retired following an incorrectly fitted right-front wheel. Alonso was ninth in the Drivers' Championship with 26 points, his lowest placing since he came sixth in 2003; he maintained his reputation as one of F1's best drivers.
